units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:7">Midd. I, 7</cite> <he>זה שהיה פתוח לעזרה פ׳ קטן היה לו וכ׳</he> the gate which opened into the court had a small wicket by which they entered to patrol &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:4">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> <he>פתח … פ׳ מתחת וכ׳</he> the Lord opened unto him a wicket under his throne of glory.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13">Num. R. s. 13</cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 5:1">Pesik. R. s. 5</cite> <he>נכנס בפ׳ ושילח וכ׳</he> he entered the palace through a wicket, and sent his crier forth saying, the king has entered the palace.

<cite ref="Gittin 54b:13">Gitt. 54ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>ורילמא דחזיניה בפ׳</he> perhaps one saw him (the high priest) through the wicket; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="Q02089"><he>פִּשְׁפְּשִׁין</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00061"><he>פִּי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Zevachim 56a:11">Zeb. 56ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 55b:9">55ᵇ</cite> <he>שני פ׳ היו וכ׳</he> (Ms. R. 2 <cite ref="Q02057"><he>פְּשׁוּפְשִׁין</he></cite>, Ms. K. <cite ref="Q02080"><he>פְּשִׁיפְשִׁין</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) two wickets, eight handbreadths high, were in the Temple chamber for the knives; <cite ref="Tosefta Zevahim 7:1">Tosef. ib. VII, 1</cite> <he>פסיפסין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>פסיפיסין</he>, corr. acc.). Zeb. l. c. <he>פִּישְׁפִּישִׁין שאני</he> it was different as regards the height of wickets.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:1">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 2:5">Yalk. ib. 2</cite> <he>היאך הוא עושה חדרים … פ׳</he> how to arrange the chambers, how to arrange the wickets (doors between the rooms).
